title: Enterprise Network Vulnerability Assessment Report
executive_summary: An automated network security assessment of target host 127.0.0.1 was conducted evaluating 103 TCP ports in Curated (103) mode. The assessment discovered 5 active listening service(s), with the maximum detected exposure reaching Critical severity and an overall risk score of 85/100 (Critical Risk). A total of 1 Critical finding(s) were correlated with publicly disclosed CVEs in NIST NVD, representing immediate vector risk. Top Priority Remediation: Configure Windows Update Delivery Optimization (WUDO) to local network peer sharing only or disable via Group Policy.

findings.remediation: Configure Windows Update Delivery Optimization (WUDO) to local network peer sharing only or disable via Group Policy.
findings.title: Critical Risk: Exposed Windows Update Delivery Optimization on Port 7680/TCP
findings.finding_title: Critical Risk: Exposed Windows Update Delivery Optimization on Port 7680/TCP
findings.description: TCP port 7680 was confirmed in the OPEN state via TCP SYN/connect handshake. Protocol probing extracted banner: "Windows Update Delivery Optimization". Identified software product: Windows. Mapped host process: svchost.exe (PID: 2656). Correlated against NIST NVD with top matching advisory CVE-1999-0241 (CVSS 10.0) (Critical severity).

findings.remediation: Restrict TCP port 135 to internal administrative jump hosts and domain controllers; block external inbound access.

Identified software product: Microsoft. Mapped host process: svchost.exe (PID: 1480). No active public CVEs directly mapped in NIST NVD for this service banner.

findings.remediation: Disable SMBv1 host-wide; apply latest Microsoft security updates; isolate port 445 to trusted administrative subnets via perimeter firewall.

findings.remediation: Update Intel AMT firmware; isolate management interface to dedicated out-of-band management VLAN.
